uncertainties.issue: 'tasukete ageta' has no object; 'I saved you' supplies 'you' as the natural reply to the accusation in 2301. What Ange saved them from is not stated.

'Dewey no nakama datta na' is the recollective past (as I recall, you are with Dewey). 'You were one of Dewey's people, right?' can be read in English as a former affiliation. Left because English also uses the past for recollection; alternative: 'You're one of Dewey's people, right?'

Causatives (furesase wa sen / jama saseru mono ka = I will not let you) rendered as 'will not lay a single finger' / 'As if the likes of you could interfere'. Defiance is preserved, the speaker's volition is not; judged different rather than wrong.
'Explain it to us' supplies 'us' (source: setsumei shite kure). Harmless, left.
'ano mujinki' number unknown (plural kept); 2291-2292 in the previous batch are singular. The fix names 'the Drive', which the source leaves to context (kadou). Still a compressed two-sentence row.
